mapper.select:
select count(1) -- from TBL_RISK r left join TBL_ORGANIZATION o on r.unit = to_char(o.orgid) from TBL_RISK r left join TBL_ORGANIZATION o on r.unit = o.orgid
r.RISKID in (select max(RISKID) from TBL_RISK group by RISKNUMBER) and ${ew.sqlSegment}

select riskid , risknumber , riskdes , belongsto , r.riskcatid , inriskdb , version , riskcreatedt , o1.orgname as zrbmName , o2.orgname as xgbmName , o3.orgname as ssjgName , r1.riskcatname as ssfxName , r.reorg , r.riskname , r.riskprogram from tbl_risk r left join tbl_organization o1 on r.belongsto = to_char(nvl(o1.orgid, 0)) left join tbl_organization o2 on r.reorg = to_char(nvl(o2.orgid, 0)) left join tbl_organization o3 on r.unit = to_char(nvl(o3.orgid, 0)) left join tbl_riskcategory r1 on r.riskcatid = r1.riskcatid where ${ew.sqlSegment}
select * from tbl_outerrule where outrulid in (select outrulid from TBL_RISK_OUTERRULE where riskid = #{riskid}) and ${ew.sqlSegment}

select r.*,r2.BUSSINESSNAME,r2.FLOWNAME,r2.SIZE,o.ORGNAME from ( select b.BUSSINESSNAME,l.FLOWNAME,case when max(rar.RISKLEVEL) is NULL then '0' else max(rar.RISKLEVEL) END as size,r.riskid from tbl_risk r left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK rar on rar.RISKID = r.RISKID left join TBL_RISK_FLOW f on r.RISKID= F.RISKID left join TBL_FLOW l on l.FLOWID= F.FLOWID left join TBL_FLOW_BUSSINESS b on b.FLOWID= F.FLOWID left join TBL_RISK_BUSINESS_DIC d on d.businessno=B.BUSSINESSNAME group by r.riskid,l.FLOWNAME,b.BUSSINESSNAME ) r2 left join tbl_risk r on r.riskid=r2.RISKID left join tbl_organization o on r.unit = o.orgid where 1=1 and
r.riskcatid in (${ids})
and (
r.closestatus not in(6) or r.closestatus is null or r.closestatus =''
r.closestatus = 6
1=1
) ${sql} and ${ew.sqlSegment}

select o.orgname as unitname, o1.orgname as belongsto, r.* from TBL_RISK r left join TBL_ORGANIZATION o on r.unit = to_char(o.orgid) left join TBL_ORGANIZATION o1 on r.belongsto = to_char(o1.orgid) where 1 = 1 and r.RISKID in (select max(RISKID) from TBL_RISK group by RISKNUMBER) and ${ew.sqlSegment}

select.if: select DISTINCT org.orgname as zrbmName,o.orgname as unitname,trc.riskcopingid,d.ORGNAME as linkDeptName, s.realname as staffname,cat.riskcatname as riskcatidname,r.* from TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK t1 left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=t1.assplanid left join tbl_risk r on r.RISKID=t1.RISKID left join tbl_organization o on r.unit = to_char(o.orgid) left join tbl_organization d on r.linkdeptid=d.orgid left join tbl_organization org on org.orgid=r.BELONGSTO left join TBL_RISK_COPING trc on trc.riskid = r.riskid left join tbl_staff s on s.staffid=r.staffid left join TBL_RISKCATEGORY cat on cat.riskcatid=r.riskcatid where p.unit is not null and p.unit=#{queryParam.unit} and ( r.riskstatus !=0 or r.riskstatus is null) and planstatus =3 ${sql} order by RISKCREATEDT desc

select distinct org.orgname as zrbmName,o.orgname as unitname,trc.riskcopingid,d.ORGNAME as linkDeptName, s.realname as staffname,cat.riskcatname as riskcatidname,r.* from TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK t4 left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=t4.assplanid left join tbl_risk r on r.RISKID=t4.RISKID left join tbl_organization o on r.unit = to_char(o.orgid) left join tbl_organization d on r.linkdeptid=d.orgid left join tbl_organization org on org.orgid=r.BELONGSTO left join TBL_RISK_COPING trc on trc.riskid = r.riskid left join tbl_staff s on s.staffid=r.staffid left join TBL_RISKCATEGORY cat on cat.riskcatid=r.riskcatid where p.unit is not null and p.unit=#{queryParam.unit} and ( r.riskstatus !=0 or r.riskstatus is null) and planstatus =1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK t5 left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=t5.assplanid WHERE t5.riskid = t4.riskid AND p.planstatus IN (2, 3) ) ${sql} order by RISKCREATEDT desc

select distinct org.orgname as zrbmName,o.orgname as unitname,trc.riskcopingid,d.ORGNAME as linkDeptName, s.realname as staffname,cat.riskcatname as riskcatidname,r.* from TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK t2 left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=t2.assplanid left join tbl_risk r on r.RISKID=t2.RISKID left join tbl_organization o on r.unit = to_char(o.orgid) left join tbl_organization d on r.linkdeptid=d.orgid left join tbl_organization org on org.orgid=r.BELONGSTO left join TBL_RISK_COPING trc on trc.riskid = r.riskid left join tbl_staff s on s.staffid=r.staffid left join TBL_RISKCATEGORY cat on cat.riskcatid=r.riskcatid where p.unit is not null and p.unit=#{queryParam.unit} and ( r.riskstatus !=0 or r.riskstatus is null) and planstatus =2 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK t3 left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=t3.assplanid WHERE t3.riskid = t2.riskid AND p.planstatus =3 ) ${sql} order by RISKCREATEDT desc

ELSE NULL END AS RISKCHANGE, cme.EVALUATION_ID AS EVALUATIONID, -- 使用WM_CONCAT替代LISTAGG，兼容低版本达梦数据库 TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DISTINCT org.orgname)) AS orgname, TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DISTINCT e.FIELD6)) AS FIELD6, r.RISKORDER AS RISKORDER FROM TBL_RISK r -- 关联风险应对表 LEFT JOIN TBL_RISK_COPING rc ON r.RISKID = rc.RISKID -- 关联一体化管控措施表 LEFT JOIN TBL_CONTROLMATRIX cm ON rc.RISKCOPINGID = cm.RISKCOPINGID -- 关联管控条目表，获取责任领导 LEFT JOIN TBL_CONTROL_ENTRIES e ON cm.CONMATID = e.CONMATID -- 关联组织信息表，获取责任部门名称 LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION org ON cm.RESPONSIBLEDEP = org.orgid -- 关联当月的月度评估数据（使用子查询替代CTE，兼容低版本DM数据库） EXTRACT(MONTH FROM me4.CREATE_TIME) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE)) ) AND me4.REPORT_BUTTON_STATUS = 1 ) ) ) cme ON r.RISKID = cme.RISKID WHERE 1=1 AND r.RISKORDER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.RISKNUMBER,
